name: Warwick Business School, University of Warwick

tuition_total.note: £62,500 for the 12-month format; £63,750 for the 16-month formats; same for Home and EU/International. Covers registration, tuition, examination, graduation, study materials, visa/travel/accommodation on the overseas elective. £6,000 deposit is part of the fee

mandatory_fees_total.note: No separate mandatory fee; not included: residential accommodation, travel for Capstone module, graduation robes/photos

living_budget_total.note: University of Warwick advice for 1-year Master's students: approx. £13,632 for a full year (page last updated 16.10.2025, academic year not named); no breakdown. UKVI floor outside London £1,171/month

scholarship.note: Scholarships of 10% to 50% of tuition (£6,250-£31,250) for September 2027 entry; Sainsbury Engineering / Science Management Fellowships £50,000 (external). No average award or share of class aided published

employment.report_url_note: Linked from https://www.wbs.ac.uk/courses/mba/full-time/careers/ as https://www.wbs.ac.uk/assets/links/brochures/mba/full-time-mba-graduate-destinations-brochure (redirects to FlippingBook; document ref 510097 01/2026)
employment.accepted_3m_note: 81% of graduates seeking employment accepted a job within 3 months

base_salary.note: Overall average salary three months post-MBA, in purchasing power parity dollars ($PPP), as published; maximum $357,675 PPP; average salary increase 44%

alumni_salary_3y_ft.stat: mean (FT Global MBA 2026 weighted alumni salary, 3 years post-MBA)

employment.changed_country_note: 37% changed location post-MBA; 43% stayed in the UK to work
employment.by_industry_note: Salaries by sector published only for the top three sectors (Finance, Technology, Energy), in $PPP; the report says other sectors are omitted for incomplete pre/post salary data. Column order read from the FlippingBook text layer (first three values = averages, last three = maxima; consistent since each max exceeds its average)
employment.by_function_note: No function breakdown published; only a list of post-MBA job titles
employment.top_employers_note: No employer list with hire counts in the 2025 report; names are those of graduates quoted in the report

profile.cohort: Graduating Class of 2025 (cohort size 70, age range 24-43)
profile.note: Work experience published only as bands (2-5, 6-10, 11-15, 16+ years), values not cleanly attributable in the text layer. Programme page (last 3 years): 48 nationalities, 40% female, average age 31

rankings_cited.note: School states 7th in the UK and 21st in Europe in the FT Global MBA Ranking 2026 (seen in search extract of the brochure page); world rank not found on a school page

notes: Salaries are in purchasing-power-parity dollars as the school publishes them, not nominal GBP.
